scope: Screen obj2cad as a potential from-scratch explicit-mesh/ACIS control author, refresh acis-core source-free SAB authoring documentation, and audit control-sample provenance boundaries.

method.evidenceBoundary: Mutable project documentation establishes project-reported features and limitations only. No output bytes, reader result, B-rep validity, or native application acceptance was reproduced. The current docs.rs crate page identifies acis-core 0.3.11, but exact source artifact/toolchain execution was not performed.

evidence.topic: obj2cad's potential as a control author
observed: The README describes a custom Rust ACIS B-rep writer for SAT/SAB and an R2018 ASCII/binary DXF writer.
The README documents a mesh-to-ACIS-surface option that retains the original mesh, plus an acis-samples command for plane, box, cylinder, cone, sphere, and torus controls.
The project labels DXF verified but DWG and curved surfaces beta until AutoCAD acceptance.
Its DWG writer path fetches a patched ACadRust dependency; the README does not establish independent DWG implementation provenance or native acceptance.
evidence.planUse: Optional control-author candidate only. Pin source, lockfile, toolchain, invocation, output version, entity forms, carrier profile, and hashes before use. Require independent parser/geometry evidence and a separately named native acceptance run.

evidence.topic: Limits of the documented verification harness
observed: The README describes a parity hash across a Rust conversion model, an independent Python OBJ parse, and DXF/DWG readback through ezdxf or ACadRust.
The README says ACIS output is read by ezdxf and ACadRust.
A coordinate/mesh parity result does not itself validate B-rep geometry, topology, owner/history closure, curved surfaces, or native application acceptance.
evidence.planUse: Score mesh-coordinate parity, raw carrier retention, typed topology, analytic geometry, wrapper association, and native acceptance as separate outcomes; do not treat same-project output hashes or parser readback as semantic proof.

observed: obj2cad describes ABC dataset test data as MIT licensed.
The dataset's own page says CAD-model copyright belongs to the creators and points to Onshape terms for licensing details.
Onshape terms distinguish public Free Plan documents from documents with greater reserved rights; the pages reviewed do not establish the permissions for every specific model in obj2cad's corpus.
evidence.planUse: Do not download, copy, or commit dataset-derived fixtures based only on a repo-level license statement. Prefer locally authored from-scratch controls; evaluate any candidate dataset sample's provenance and exact rights before use.

observed: The current docs.rs page identifies acis-core 0.3.11, superseding the prior 0.3.8 documentation snapshot.
It documents experimental source-free ASM23200 metric-box SAB authoring with an 86-active-entity profile and bounded dimensions/coordinates, plus a limited analytic B-rep authoring API.

Its documentation states reference closure is not B-rep validity or vendor-version compatibility; analytic authoring has absent pcurves, and general transforms, attributes, arbitrary history, and whole DWG/DXF integration are not provided by the documented profile.
The crate is part of the cadmpeg/cq-acis project lineage and is not an independent kernel/parser vote.
evidence.planUse: Keep as a narrow optional source-free authoring helper, not a reader or semantic oracle. Pin exact source/toolchain and validate output independently; do not promote it to general ACIS support.

nextActions: Continue the local implementation queue without installing or building either candidate per slice.
At the existing composed checkpoint, preflight immutable source/tag, license, lockfile, toolchain, buildability, deterministic output, and exact DXF/SAT/SAB entity profile.
Use only hand-authored from-scratch controls in a temporary directory; do not add generated DWG/DXF fixtures to the repository.
Separate coordinate parity, payload/owner transport, parsed topology, analytic shape validity, and native application acceptance.
Require sample-specific rights verification before using any ABC dataset model.

planDelta.summary: Added obj2cad as an optional potential from-scratch control-author route, clarified the structural-versus-semantic proof limits and beta/native gate, refreshed acis-core from 0.3.8 to the currently published 0.3.11 documentation snapshot, and tightened per-sample ABC dataset provenance/rights screening. No support claim or local implementation ordering changed.
